title: Sebastian Kanovich - Powering Emerging Markets Payments - [Founder’s Field Guide, EP. 56]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Sebastian Kanovich, CEO of payments company dLocal.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Sebastian Kanovich, CEO of payments company dLocal. Sebastian founded dLocal in 2016 to bridge the infrastructure gap between payments in developed and emerging markets. Since then, the initially bootstrapped start-up has enabled global merchants like Uber, Spotify, and Google to service billions of emerging market users.

key_points.text: And in doing so, dLocal has created $10bn of equity market value, having IPOd last year.
Our discussion covers dLocal’s playbook for facilitating payments in emerging countries, what Sebastian has learned about great API building.
Please enjoy my conversation with Sebastian Kanovich.
